children.text: What makes up the price of SEO
"SEO" isn't one service — it's four blocks of work. The price depends on how much of each your site actually needs:
1. Technical foundation.
Speed, structure, metadata, Schema.org, fixing indexation issues. A big one-off block at the start, then maintenance.
2. Content.
Pages for commercial queries and articles for informational ones. This is SEO's main fuel: every page is a separate entry point from search.
3. Authority.
Links, mentions, directories, reviews. The slowest and most expensive block — and the one separating top-3 from page three.
4. Local SEO.
Google Business Profile, reviews, a "service + area" structure. For local businesses — clinics, builders, solicitors — this is half the result.

children.text: Why "guaranteed #1" is a red flag

Google doesn't sell positions and no contractor controls the algorithm. Honest work sounds like this: "we'll build the site to the standards Google rewards, then grow content and authority — first results in 3–6 months". Anyone guaranteeing #1 in a month is either charging for air or using grey tactics that get sites filtered later.

Our model is different: every site we build is SEO-ready from day one — structure, 90+ speed scores, Schema.org and local SEO are part of the development price, and a year of technical support is included in every package. children.text: What "turnkey" actually means

"Turnkey" is a worn-out word, so here it is literally. The price includes everything a working site needs: structure and copy, design, build, online booking, a practitioner directory, a price list, a CMS, domain, hosting, launch and a year of support. Not included: photography (we start with your photos and quality stock) and advertising. You don't write a spec or hunt for references — that's our job.
Week 1: brief and structure

It starts with a 30-minute call: your clinic's arms, who your patients are, where enquiries come from today. Then we analyse 3–5 competitor clinics in your area and build the page map: home, services, practitioners, prices, contact — up to 8 pages in the base package. You get the structure to sign off. Your involvement: 1–2 hours.
Week 2: design

The designer builds the home page and a typical service page layout. Medical specifics: a calm palette, real photos instead of stock, a prominent booking button on every screen, typography a 60+ audience can read. Two rounds of revisions included. Your involvement: about an hour of feedback.
Week 3: build and integrations

The build, the CMS, and the thing that matters most for a clinic — online booking: service, practitioner and time slot in 2 clicks, an SMS confirmation for the patient, a notification for reception. We connect your practice management system or CRM. Load time — under 1.5 seconds on mobile. Your involvement: 0 hours.

Днепр — промышленный и торговый центр с сильным сегментом услуг: медицина, строительство, оборудование, оптовые поставки. Идея выглядит логично и в девяти случаях из десяти вредит. Правило простое: страница района оправдана ровно тогда, когда за ней стоит физическая разница — свой адрес, свои часы работы, свои врачи, свои цены. Если вы можете заполнить её реальными данными — делайте. Если единственное отличие в тексте это название района — не делайте, сделайте вместо этого одну сильную страницу услуги и нормально оформленные карточки в Google.

Уточните, на кого оформляются домен и хостинг. Правильный ответ — на вас, а не на студию.
